pages.title: Dhole
pages.text: The dhole ($(o)Cuon alpinus$()), or Asiatic wild dog, is a canid native to the forests of Central, South, East and Southeast Asia.$(br2)Dholes live in highly social packs that cooperate to hunt deer and other large prey, and keep in contact with distinctive whistling calls.$(br2)During the Pleistocene, dholes also ranged across Europe.
